column1: # tools/test/known.tsv -- failures a selected test is known to have, and why.
# A known failure is still a failure: tools/test/affected.rb prints it under
# the test it belongs to, so a run that shows it is read against this row and
# not mistaken for one the change caused, and a run that does not show it
# says the row can go. A row is added only with the reason and the revision
# where the failure was shown to exist without the change.
#   id      the test's id in tools/test/tests.tsv
#   check   the lane and check that fails, as the test prints it
#   since   a revision where it already failed
#   reason  what fails, and whose it is

upstream Spinel f8ff01939 stores a String variable as a mutable handle, so GpuRaster#frame passes @wad (an `in` u8 buffer) as sp_str_dup(sp_strbuf_read_pub(iv_wad)) and copies the whole WAD on every GPU frame; the screen and zone handles are still borrowed. Accepted for the 2026-11-14 synchronisation (the bpf-mlir coordinator); a borrow route for an `in` buffer from a handle is an open follow-up on the fork (a bpf-mlir implementer)
